newsitem.title: USA: HOT STOCKS HIGHLIGHTS - Earnings move shares.
newsitem.headline: HOT STOCKS HIGHLIGHTS - Earnings move shares.

text.p: KIMBERLY-CLARK CORP - Reported second quarter operating earnings of $0.60 a share compared to $0.56 a share a year ago. The household and paper products company also said it sees its second half results in the "same ballpark" as the first half. Stock fell 3-5/16 to 48-1/4.

BOEING CO - reported second quarter earnings of $0.48 a share compared to $0.68 a share a year ago. Higher research and development expenses, joint venture development expenses and a higher effective income tax rate offset a 48 percent increase in sales. Off 1-1/8 to 54-7/8.

HUTCHINSON TECHNOLOGY INC - Reported third quarter earnings of $0.68 a share compared to $0.31 a share. The company also said it expects fourth quarter shipments of conventional suspensions to fall about five percent. Down 2-1/2 to 29.

AT&T CORP - Reported second quarter earnings from continuing operations of $0.59 a share compared to $0.95 a share a year ago. The company said the second quarter results were the low point for the company and year-over-year comparisons should become more favorable in future quarters. Down 1/16 to 34-3/8.
BELLSOUTH CORP - Posted second quarter operating earnings of $0.71 a share, up 12.7 percent froma year earlier and slightly above analysts' estimates. Up 12/16 to 45-13/16.

EXXON CORP - Reported second quarter earnings of $0.79 a share, above last year's $0.63 a share and ahead of Wall Street estimates. The company cited downstream and chemical margin improvement for the 25 percent rise and net income. Product sales were the highest for over 20 years. Up 12/16 to 61-3/16.

HOST MARRIOTT CORP - Second quarter earnings increase to $0.13 a share from $0.03 a share. Earnings before interest expense, taxes, depreciation and amortization and other non-cash items (EBITDA) rose to $174 million from $107 million. Gained 51/6 to 19-1/2.
